//! GREEN fixture for `tenant-predicate` — the EB-09 Bus-stream leg (P-045). The lint MUST admit
//! this module (the leg is ARMED here — the `@bus-stream` marker makes the admission meaningful,
//! not an inert pass). The consumer subscribes to a BOUNDED, per-(tenant, subsystem) stream: the
//! `StreamScope` pins both the `TenantId` and the `Subsystem`, and the subject is the cell-local
//! `evt.<tenant>.<subsystem>...` whitelist (never `*`) — refined-arch event-bus §7.1 + §4.2 gotcha 1.
//! The subscription is scoped to exactly one tenant's one subsystem, so no cross-tenant frames leak.
//! @bus-stream

pub async fn start_consumer(bus: &Bus, tenant_id: TenantId) -> SubStream {
    // OK: a bounded (tenant, subsystem) StreamScope — whitelisted, never `*`.
    let scope = StreamScope::new(tenant_id, Subsystem::Issues);
    bus.subscribe(scope.subject(), scope)
        .await
        .expect("subscribe")
}
